notes:
New Features:

+ Guljaj now inspects MPEG-TS segments for real video/audio tracks and H.264/MPEG-2 dimensions, stores the detected resolution, and shows it beside channel names like the other Sites.

+ Normal Guljaj playback prefers the public Free stream only when both video and audio are confirmed; otherwise the logged-in Live stream remains available as the safe fallback.

Bugfixes:

- Removes the unwanted Online channel prefix from Guljaj names while preserving the website channel title itself.

- Restores one-click Guljaj playback when Cumination invokes the item without a resolved-URL plugin handle; right-click Play remains compatible.

- Stream comparison continues to use the complete URL/path before index.m3u8, so channels sharing the same index.m3u8 filename are not treated as duplicates.
